If hypoxic (SpO2 <90% or ≥3 L O2) or unstable, admit, start empiric infectious coverage, discuss with pulm/ID/oncology before methylprednisolone 1 mg/kg IV daily
Respiratory isolation: surgical mask in public, no close contacts, airborne precautions for visits/admission until TB excluded
Sputum AFB smear and mycobacterial culture x3 (induced sputum if not productive), plus MTB NAAT (Xpert) on at least one specimen, within days
Bronchoscopy with BAL via pulmonology within 1 week if sputum is nondiagnostic or she is worsening
At bronchoscopy: BAL AFB/NAAT, bacterial/fungal/nocardia cultures, galactomannan, PJP PCR, viral PCR, cell count, cytology; consider transbronchial biopsy if unclear
If TB confirmed or strongly suspected (positive smear/NAAT), start weight-based RIPE with pyridoxine, notify public health, involve ID
If active TB excluded and bacterial bronchiolitis suspected, doxycycline 100 mg BID 5–7 days; avoid fluoroquinolones and macrolide monotherapy
Once active TB excluded, treat latent TB with rifampin 4 months (or isoniazid 6–9 months with pyridoxine)
If infection excluded/treated and immune-related process confirmed, prednisone 1 mg/kg/day (~60 mg) with 8–12 week taper; steroid-sparing agents IVIG/MMF
PJP prophylaxis with TMP-SMX three times weekly, only when prednisone ≥20 mg/day expected ≥4 weeks
Sputum bacterial and fungal culture
Order SARS-CoV-2/influenza/RSV PCR as standalone blood/other test
Order CBC with differential, CMP, and CRP
Order HIV Ag/Ab and hepatitis B/C serologies
Order serum galactomannan and beta-D-glucan (plus HbA1c, uric acid)
8 AM cortisol (± ACTH stimulation) to screen for HPA-axis suppression; hydrocortisone if <3 µg/dL
Order full PFTs with DLCO and resting/ambulatory SpO2
Repeat CT only if symptoms progress
Do not repeat the IGRA (already positive, will not discriminate latent from active)
Hold checkpoint inhibitor until diagnosis clear; call oncologist today to coordinate (recurrent grade ≥2 usually permanent discontinuation)
Benzonatate 100–200 mg TID PRN for dry cough
Pulmonology referral within 1 week (same day if hypoxic) for bronchoscopy
Infectious disease referral within 1 week, urgent if AFB or NAAT positive
